description.value:
Frequency once per day

You extend your innate ability to alter your personal gravity to harm another creature within 120 feet, the intense pressure buckling their bones. You deal @Damage[10d8[bludgeoning]] damage to the creature with a @Check[type:fortitude|against:class-spell|basic] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. On a failure, the creature also becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Suppressed] and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 1} until the beginning of your next turn.
